title: On Referring to the old agreement twice
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：refer　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 refer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the coach ① referred to the old agreement twice with great care, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② refers to the old agreement twice on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ refer to the old agreement twice at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ referred to the old agreement twice before — a line in the record for April 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Referring to the old agreement twice with great care, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ refer to the book before every answer on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Refer to the book before every answer at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ refers to the book before every answer with great care every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ referred to the old agreement twice again when nobody else would.

⑩ To refer to the old agreement twice, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody refers to the old agreement twice on the same day again and somebody must refer to the old agreement twice with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 提及（一般过去式 referred to the old agreement twice：1952 年教练头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 提及（一般现在 refers to the old agreement twice：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 提及（不定式 to refer to the old agreement twice：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 提及（过去完成时 had referred to the old agreement twice：1946 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 提及（动名词 referring to the old agreement twice 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 查阅（refer to the book before every answer：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去查阅每次答话前都要翻书）
G. v. 查阅（refer to the book before every answer：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 提及（后段两处：新来的队员照例 refers to the book before every answer，而母亲又一次 referred to the old agreement twice）

answers.why: refer 意为“提及”，1952 年教练小心翼翼地提及两次提到那份旧协议，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 referred。
refer 意为“提及”，自那以后教练当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 refers。
refer 意为“提及”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯提及两次提到那份旧协议”，此处为不定式 to refer to the old agreement twice。
refer 意为“提及”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人提及过，故用过去完成时 had referred。
refer 意为“提及”，教练说“提及两次提到那份旧协议这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 referring to the old agreement twice 作主语。
refer 意为“查阅”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去查阅每次答话前都要翻书”，should ever 之后用原形 refer to the book before every answer。
refer 意为“查阅”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻查阅每次答话前都要翻书（refer to the book before every answer at once），以后再也不要提起。
refer 意为“提及”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例查阅每次答话前都要翻书，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 refers。
refer 意为“提及”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地提及两次提到那份旧协议，用一般过去式 referred 叙述。
refer 意为“提及”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要提及两次提到那份旧协议，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 refer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the coach referred to the old agreement twice with great care, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach refers to the old agreement twice on the same day whenever the field asks.
Referring to the old agreement twice with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever refer to the book before every answer on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field refers to the book before every answer with great care every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother referred to the old agreement twice again, and the field remembered that half.
